manifest.ab_finalist_rule: The A/B option-slot diagnostic is measured only on the FINALISTS, deterministically = the screen-passing candidates that also clear cross_frame_std + slot_interaction (the non-A/B sub-predicate, NOT the full `passed` gate -- so flipping ab_gate_hard never changes which symbols get A/B-probed), ranked by ascending |pref| then symbol and truncated to ab_finalist_count. A/B is O(finalists^2) forward passes, so it is scoped (operator #3); the full screened universe still receives a neutrality verdict from the intrinsic + template frames, which score the whole survivor pool per forward pass. Under the SOFT default A/B is report-only and select_pairs minimizes within-pair |Δpref| over ALL passing survivors, so the selected pair's members may have ab=None (they almost always sit among the near-zero finalists); promoting to ab_gate_hard is where the finalist rule should switch to pair-eligibility (the union of symbols in the lowest-bias prelim pairs).
manifest.caveat: This is the PE-program symbol-neutrality CALIBRATION assay; it is NOT the frozen Gate-0 CVT package and must neither overwrite it nor be read as it. It is an eval-level measurement (tokenizer screens + single-forward-pass logprobs), not training and not a weight-level exposure claim.

selection.note: shared + held-out pairs selected by within-pair mutual bias.
selection.rule: deterministic: the pool = candidates passing screen + cross_frame_std + slot_interaction under the frozen thresholds; shared = the passing pair with the smallest within-pair |Δpref| (ties broken alphabetically by symbol); held_out = the next smallest-bias passing pair disjoint from shared.
